title: MMSkillRisk: Can Agents Stay Safe When Multimodal Skills Become Traps?
abstract: arXiv:2609.35912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills are shareable packages of procedural instructions, tools, and examples. Multimodal skills additionally include visual references that agents retrieve and inspect during execution. Because these images guide actions, attackers can disguise malicious instructions as ordinary visual guidance within otherwise legitimate skills. Existing skill-security research primarily examines text-carried attacks or scanner detection, leaving the runtime effects of image-borne attacks insufficiently evaluated. We introduce MMSkillRisk, to our knowledge the first publicly available benchmark dedicated to end-to-end safety evaluation of image-borne attacks in multimodal skills. To instantiate this attack surface, we design Native-Context Visual Attack (NCVA), which disguises malicious instructions as native components of teaching images, such as annotations and interface labels. translated_title: MMSkillRisk：当多模态技能变成陷阱时，智能体还能保持安全吗？
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是可共享的程序性指令、工具和示例的集合包。多模态技能还额外包含智能体在执行过程中会检索和查看的视觉参考内容。由于这些图像会引导智能体的行为，攻击者可以将恶意指令伪装成普通的视觉引导，隐藏在看似合法的技能之中。现有的技能安全研究主要考察文本承载的攻击或扫描器检测，而对图像承载攻击在运行时造成的影响评估不足。我们提出了 MMSkillRisk，据我们所知，这是首个公开可用的、专门针对多模态技能中图像承载攻击进行端到端安全评估的基准。为了构建这一攻击面，我们设计了原生上下文视觉攻击（NCVA），它将恶意指令伪装成教学图像的原生组成部分，例如标注和界面标签。随附的 SKILL.md 文件提供辅助引导，促使智能体（后文被截断）
tldr: 提出了首个针对多模态智能体技能中图像承载攻击的端到端安全评估公开基准 MMSkillRisk，并设计了将恶意指令伪装成教学图像原生元素（如标注、界面标签）的原生上下文视觉攻击（NCVA）。
en_tdlr: We introduce MMSkillRisk, the first publicly available benchmark for end-to-end safety evaluation of image-borne attacks in multimodal agent skills, together with Native-Context Visual Attack (NCVA), which disguises malicious instructions as native components of teaching images such as annotations and interface labels.
